rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice when competitive means able to compete successfully.

example.english: Our team is competitive this year, so don't underestimate us.
example.traditional: 我哋隊今年有競爭力，唔好睇少我哋。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 deoi6 gam1 nin4 jau5 ging3 zang1 lik6 m4 hou2 tai2 siu2 ngo5 dei6

rows.note: Use this for someone who is competitive by nature and strongly wants to win.

example.english: They have always been competitive and can't stand losing even one round.
example.traditional: 佢由細到大都好勝，輸一舖都唔服氣。
example.jyutping: keoi5 jau4 sai3 dou3 daai6 dou1 hou2 sing3 syu1 jat1 pou3 dou1 m4 fuk6 hei3

rows.note: Use this for a quality product or service that is attractively cheap or good value.

example.english: The lunch at this café is really competitive: good quality at a low price.
example.traditional: 呢間茶餐廳嘅午餐真係平靚正。
example.jyutping: ni1 gaan1 caa4 caan1 teng1 ge3 ng5 caan1 zan1 hai6 ping4 leng3 zeng3
